It’s time for Pokémon Growth Week! This week-long event is a special opportunity to get more Sleep EXP and candies than usual. Let’s all try to get plenty of sleep to help raise our favorite helper Pokémon! Event Period: • Monday, July 1, at 4:00 a.m. to Monday, July 8, at 3:59 a.m. Event Areas: • All areas Bonuses — All Days (7/1 to 7/7) — • Helper Pokémon Sleep EXP ×1.5 • Candies gained from the first sleep research of the day ×1.5 Notes about the Event • [Important] Each day of Pokémon Growth Week rolls over at 4:00 a.m. • The event’s candy bonus does not apply to the second sleep session of the day. • Event bonuses apply only to sleep data tracked during the event. • If you wait to report sleep data tracked before the event began and select “Review Later” during the event, event bonuses will not be applied. • If you wait to report sleep data tracked during the event and select “Review Later” after the event has ended, event bonuses will be applied. • Event bonuses do not apply to sleep tracking during the tutorial. • Event bonuses will trigger regardless of which site you conduct your sleep research in. • The effects of incense stack with the event bonuses. If you use Growth Incense during the event, EXP gains will be multiplied by 3 (×1.5 from the event bonus and ×2 from the Growth Incense bonus).
